verses.sloka: युध्यमानौ तु तौ दृष्ट्वा प्रसक्तौ नराक्षसौ।प्रभिन्नाविव मातङ्गौ परस्परवधैषिणौ ।। ६.९०.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: yudhyamānau tu tau dṛṣṭvā prasaktau narākṣasau।prabhinnāviva mātaṅgau parasparavadhaiṣiṇau ।। 6.90.1 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana (man) and Indrajith (Rakshasa) were fond of battle and intending to win in the fight overcoming each other. Each of them were like elephants but were broken into pieces. Vibheeshana, with eagerness to witness the battle stood in the forefront of the battlefield watching the fight.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्ड का चौरासी सग पूरा हुआ । ज २) 22) पञ्चाशीतितमः सगः + ७३० ना 0222 तस्य तद्वचनं शरुत्वा राघवः शोककशितः । नोपधारयते व्यक्तं यदुक्तं तेन रक्षसा

verses.sloka: तौ द्रष्टुकामः सङ्ग्रामे परस्परगतौ बली।शूरः स रावणभ्राता तस्थौ सङ्ग्राममूर्धनि ।। ६.९०.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau draṣṭukāmaḥ saṅgrāme parasparagatau balī।śūraḥ sa rāvaṇabhrātā tasthau saṅgrāmamūrdhani ।। 6.90.2 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana (man) and Indrajith (Rakshasa) were fond of battle and intending to win in the fight overcoming each other. Each of them were like elephants but were broken into pieces. Vibheeshana, with eagerness to witness the battle stood in the forefront of the battlefield watching the fight.
translations.hindi: शत्रुनाशकारी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी धीरज धारण कर वानरों के उससीप बैठे हुए विभीषण से बोले

verses.sloka: ततो विस्फारयामास महद्धनुरवस्थितः।उत्ससर्ज च तीक्ष्णाग्रान् राक्षसेषु महाशरान् ।। ६.९०.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato visphārayāmāsa mahaddhanuravasthitaḥ।utsasarja ca tīkṣṇāgrān rākṣaseṣu mahāśarān ।। 6.90.3 ।।

translations.english: Then Vibheeshana stood with stretched bow and loosened sharp pointed arrows on Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: ते शराः शिखिसङ्काशा निपतन्तः समाहिताः।राक्षसान् दारयामासुर्वज्राणीव महागिरीन् ।। ६.९०.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: te śarāḥ śikhisaṅkāśā nipatantaḥ samāhitāḥ।rākṣasān dārayāmāsurvajrāṇīva mahāgirīn ।। 6.90.4 ।।

translations.english: Those burning arrows falling on Rakshasas touched the Rakshasas and split them like thunderbolt splitting mountains.
translations.hindi: ह राक्षसराज बिभीषण! तुमने अभी जो कुछ मुझसे कहा-- ० पीतः ओने. हमे, उऊ पतर नता. ला Rb tee i पत्ब्नाशीतितमः सगः ६२%, राघवस्य वचः श्रुस्वा वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः । यत्तत्‌ पुनरिदं वाक्यं बभाषे स॒ विभीषणः

verses.sloka: विभीषणस्यानुचरास्ते ऽपि शूलासिपट्टिशैः।चिच्छिदुः समरे वीरान् राक्षसान् राक्षसोत्तमाः ।। ६.९०.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇasyānucarāste 'pi śūlāsipaṭṭiśaiḥ।cicchiduḥ samare vīrān rākṣasān rākṣasottamāḥ ।। 6.90.5 ।।

translations.english: Followers of Vibheeshana, the foremost of Rakshasa heroes, were shattered by the pikes, swords, and sharpedged spears in the battle.
translations.hindi: है महावीर ! तुमने जिस प्रकार मोरचों पर सेना निथुक्त : करने की आज्ञा दी थी, उसी प्रकार मेंने सेना नियत कर दी

verses.sloka: राक्षसैस्तैः परिवृतः स तदा तु विभीषणः।बभौ मध्ये प्रहृष्टानां कलभानामिव द्विपः ।। ६.९०.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasaistaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sa tadā tu vibhīṣaṇaḥ।babhau madhye prahṛṣṭānāṁ kalabhānāmiva dvipaḥ ।। 6.90.6 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana surrounded by Rakshasas shone like an elephant in the midst of young elephants.
translations.hindi: मेंने समस्त सेना के कई दल करके उन्हें चारों ओर नियत कर दिया है। फिर उन सैन्य दलों के ऊपर अलग अलम ( युद्धबिद्या के नियमानुसार) यथायोग्य सेनापति भी :नियुक्त. कर दिए हैं

verses.sloka: ततः सञ्चोदयानो वै हरीन् रक्षो रणप्रियान्।उवाच वचनं काले कालज्ञो रक्षसां वरः ।। ६.९०.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sañcodayāno vai harīn rakṣo raṇapriyān।uvāca vacanaṁ kāle kālajño rakṣasāṁ varaḥ ।। 6.90.7 ।।

translations.english: Then Vibheeshana, who is a knower of what is the right time to act spoke to Vanaras to embolden them who were eager to fight with Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: हे महायशस्वी ! मुझे तुमसे ( इसके अतिरिक्त) ओर भी कुछ कहना है | उसे भो सुन लो तुमको सन्तप्त देख, हम लोगों का हृदय भी बड़ा सन्तप्त हो रहा हे

verses.sloka: एको ऽयं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य परायणमिव स्थितः।एतच्छेषं बलं तस्य किं तिष्ठत हरीश्वराः ।। ६.९०.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: eko 'yaṁ rākṣasendrasya parāyaṇamiva sthitaḥ।etaccheṣaṁ balaṁ tasya kiṁ tiṣṭhata harīśvarāḥ ।। 6.90.8 ।।

translations.english: "Oh Vanara leaders! He (Indrajith) is the only one who is left in the Rakshasa army. Why do you stand idle?"

verses.sloka: अस्मिन् विनिहते पापे राक्षसे रणमूर्धनि।रावणं वर्जयित्वा तु शेषमस्य हतं बलम् ।। ६.९०.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: asmin vinihate pāpe rākṣase raṇamūrdhani।rāvaṇaṁ varjayitvā tu śeṣamasya hataṁ balam ।। 6.90.9 ।।

translations.english: "If this wicked Rakshasa is struck down, except Ravana all his army is killed."

verses.sloka: प्रहस्तो निहतो वीरो निकुम्भश्च महाबलः।कुम्भकर्णश्च कुम्भश्च धूम्राक्षश्च निशाचरः ।। ६.९०.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: prahasto nihato vīro nikumbhaśca mahābalaḥ।kumbhakarṇaśca kumbhaśca dhūmrākṣaśca niśācaraḥ ।। 6.90.10 ।।

translations.english: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."
translations.hindi: तो हे रघुनन्दन ! जो कुछ में तुम्हारी भलाई के लिए कहता हूँ, उसे ध्यान देकर सुनो। बह यह कि, लक्ष्मण जी एक बड़ी बानरों की सेना लेकर चलें

verses.sloka: जम्बुमाली महामाली तीक्ष्णवेगो ऽशनिप्रभः।सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च वज्रदंष्ट्रश्च राक्षसः ।। ६.९०.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: jambumālī mahāmālī tīkṣṇavego 'śaniprabhaḥ।suptaghno yajñakopaśca vajradaṁṣṭraśca rākṣasaḥ ।। 6.90.11 ।।

translations.english: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."

verses.sloka: संह्रादी विकटो निघ्नस्तपनो दम एव च।प्रघासः प्रघसश्चैव प्रजङ्घो जङ्घ एव च ।। ६.९०.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: saṁhrādī vikaṭo nighnastapano dama eva ca।praghāsaḥ praghasaścaiva prajaṅgho jaṅgha eva ca ।। 6.90.12 ।।

translations.english: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."

verses.sloka: अग्निकेतुश्च दुर्धर्षो रश्मिकेतुश्च वीर्यवान्।विद्युज्जिह्वो द्विजिह्वश्च सूर्यशत्रुश्च राक्षसः ।। ६.९०.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: agniketuśca durdharṣo raśmiketuśca vīryavān।vidyujjihvo dvijihvaśca sūryaśatruśca rākṣasaḥ ।। 6.90.13 ।।

translations.english: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."
translations.hindi: ब्रह्मशिर नामक अख ओर इच्द्राचारी घोड़े प्राप्न किए हैं । इस समय निश्चय ही वह अपनी सेना सहित निकुम्भिक्षा देवी के स्थान पर है

verses.sloka: अकम्पनः सुपार्श्वश्च चक्रमाली च राक्षसः।कम्पनः सत्त्ववन्तौ तौ देवान्तकनरान्तकौ ।। ६.९०.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: akampanaḥ supārśvaśca cakramālī ca rākṣasaḥ।kampanaḥ sattvavantau tau devāntakanarāntakau ।। 6.90.14 ।।

translations.english: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."

verses.sloka: एतान्निहत्यातिबलान् बहून् राक्षससत्तमान्।बाहुभ्यां सागरं तीर्त्वा लङ्घ्यतां गोष्पदं लघु ।। ६.९०.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: etānnihatyātibalān bahūn rākṣasasattamān।bāhubhyāṁ sāgaraṁ tīrtvā laṅghyatāṁ goṣpadaṁ laghu ।। 6.90.15 ।।

translations.english: "You have made short of many exceedingly mighty leaders of Rakshasas and swum the ocean. You cross this hoof mark of a cow without delay."

verses.sloka: एतावदेव शेषं वो जेतव्यमिह वानराः।हताः सर्वे समागम्य राक्षसा बलदर्पिताः ।। ६.९०.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: etāvadeva śeṣaṁ vo jetavyamiha vānarāḥ।hatāḥ sarve samāgamya rākṣasā baladarpitāḥ ।। 6.90.16 ।।

translations.english: "O Vanaras! Left over Rakshasas only to be conquered now. Rakshasas, who were proud of their might have been killed on meeting you."
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! अतः उस बुद्धिमान को इसी प्रकार मारना चाहिए | अथवा इस प्रकार उम्चका मारा जाना निश्चित है । अतः हे राम ! महाबली लक्ष्मण को उसके मारने की आज्ञा दो

verses.sloka: अयुक्तं निधनं कर्तुं पुत्रस्य जनितुर्मम।घृणामपास्य रामार्थे निहन्यां भ्रातुरात्मजम् ।। ६.९०.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ayuktaṁ nidhanaṁ kartuṁ putrasya janiturmama।ghṛṇāmapāsya rāmārthe nihanyāṁ bhrāturātmajam ।। 6.90.17 ।।

translations.english: "For the sake of Rama, I will strike my brother's son. Being a father, taking pity, I am helpless as it is not proper for me to take the life of my son."
translations.hindi: re it, i क > १२८ युद्धकाण्डे यदि मेघनाद मार डाला गया तो समझ लो कि रावण भी अपने खुहदों के साथ मारा जा जुका है | विभींषशा की इन बालों को खुन श्रीरामचन्द्र जी बोले

verses.sloka: हन्तुकामस्य मे बाष्पं चक्षुश्चैव निरुद्ध्यति।तमेवैष महाबाहुर्लक्ष्मणः शमयिष्यति।वानरा घ्नत सम्भूय भृत्यानस्य समीपगान् ।। ६.९०.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: hantukāmasya me bāṣpaṁ cakṣuścaiva niruddhyati।tamevaiṣa mahābāhurlakṣmaṇaḥ śamayiṣyati।vānarā ghnata sambhūya bhṛtyānasya samīpagān ।। 6.90.18 ।।

translations.english: "I wish to kill him, tears are clouding my eyes. Mighty armed Lakshmana will kill him. Vanaras collected together are coming near him and can destroy his attendants."
translations.hindi: हदै सत्यपराक्रमी ! में उस घोर निशाचर की माया को भली आंति जानता हूँ । वह ब्रह्माख्न का चलाना जानता है। वह बडा क्खकान है ओर बडा मायावी है

verses.sloka: इति तेनातियशसा राक्षसेनाभिचोदिताः।वानरेन्द्रा जहृषिरे लाङ्गूलानि च विव्यधुः ।। ६.९०.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: iti tenātiyaśasā rākṣasenābhicoditāḥ।vānarendrā jahṛṣire lāṅgūlāni ca vivyadhuḥ ।। 6.90.19 ।।

translations.english: Incited by the encouraging words of Vibheeshana (Rakshasa), Vanara chiefs rejoiced and went shaking their tails.

verses.sloka: ततस्ते कपिशार्दूलाः क्ष्वेलन्तश्च मुहुर्मुहुः।मुमुचुर्विविधान्नादान् मेघान् दृष्ट्वेव बर्हिणः ।। ६.९०.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: tataste kapiśārdūlāḥ kṣvelantaśca muhurmuhuḥ।mumucurvividhānnādān meghān dṛṣṭveva barhiṇaḥ ।। 6.90.20 ।।

translations.english: Then the tigers among monkeys again and again roaring in seeing the clouds made several kinds of sounds like peacocks.

verses.sloka: जाम्बवानपि तैः सर्वैः स्वयूथैरपि संवृतः।अश्मभिस्ताडयामास नखैर्दन्तैश्च राक्षसान् ।। ६.९०.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: jāmbavānapi taiḥ sarvaiḥ svayūthairapi saṁvṛtaḥ।aśmabhistāḍayāmāsa nakhairdantaiśca rākṣasān ।। 6.90.21 ।।

translations.english: All the troops surrounded by Jambavan too, pierced the Rakshasas with their nails and teeth.
translations.hindi: हर पञ्चाशीतितमः सग: ६२६ कीर्तिमान लक्ष्मण जी से बोले | तुम कपिराज की समस्त सेना को तथा हनुमानादि प्रभुख यूथपतियों को और भालुओं की सेनासहित जास्बवान्‌ को अपने साथ ले कर जाओ

verses.sloka: निघ्नन्तमृक्षाधिपतिं राक्षसास्ते महाबलाः।परिवव्रुभयं त्यक्त्वा तमनेकविधायुधाः ।। ६.९०.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: nighnantamṛkṣādhipatiṁ rākṣasāste mahābalāḥ।parivavrubhayaṁ tyaktvā tamanekavidhāyudhāḥ ।। 6.90.22 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas who were endowed with mighty strength giving up fear, armed with different kinds of weapons surrounded Jambavan, the Lord of Bears.

verses.sloka: शरैः परशुभिस्तीक्ष्णैः पट्टिशैर्यष्टितोमरैः।जाम्बवन्तं मृधे जघ्नुर्निघ्नन्तं राक्षसीं चमूम् ।। ६.९०.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: śaraiḥ paraśubhistīkṣṇaiḥ paṭṭiśairyaṣṭitomaraiḥ।jāmbavantaṁ mṛdhe jaghnurnighnantaṁ rākṣasīṁ camūm ।। 6.90.23 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas then assailed Jambvan who was destroying the Rakshasa army with axes, pointed arrows, iron bars and sharpedged spears.
translations.hindi: ओर उस मायाबी रावणात्मज इन्द्रजीत को मारो। अपने चारों मन्त्रियां को लिये हुए यह महात्मा बिभीषण, जो उस स्थान को ( निकुम्भिला ) जानते हैं, तुम्हारे पीछे पीछे जाँयगे श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की इन बातों को सुन, लक्ष्मण नी विभीषण के साथ हो लिए

verses.sloka: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुलः सञ्जज्ञे कपिरक्षसाम्।देवासुराणां क्रुद्धानां यथा भीमो महास्वनः ।। ६.९०.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa samprahārastumulaḥ sañjajñe kapirakṣasām।devāsurāṇāṁ kruddhānāṁ yathā bhīmo mahāsvanaḥ ।। 6.90.24 ।।

translations.english: Fearful and vehement battle took place between enraged Vanaras and Rakshasas making loud clamours like the battle (in the past) between Devas and asuras.

verses.sloka: हनुमानपि सङ्क्रुद्धः सालमुत्पाट्य वीर्यवान्।रक्षसां कदनं चक्रे समासाद्य सहस्रशः ।। ६.९०.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: hanumānapi saṅkruddhaḥ sālamutpāṭya vīryavān।rakṣasāṁ kadanaṁ cakre samāsādya sahasraśaḥ ।। 6.90.25 ।।

translations.english: Great selfHanuman too became furious and dismounting Lakshmana from his back uprooted a sala tree from a mountain and went on exterminating thousands of Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: स दत्त्वा तुमुलं युद्धं पितृव्यस्येन्द्रजिद्युधि।लक्ष्मणं परवीरघ्नं पुनरेवाभ्यधावत ।। ६.९०.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa dattvā tumulaṁ yuddhaṁ pitṛvyasyendrajidyudhi।lakṣmaṇaṁ paravīraghnaṁ punarevābhyadhāvata ।। 6.90.26 ।।

translations.english: Great selfHanuman too became furious and dismounting Lakshmana from his back uprooted a sala tree from a mountain and went on exterminating thousands of Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर श्रीरामचन्ट्र जीं के चरणों को छूकर वे हर्षित हो बोले । आज मैरे धनुब से छूटे हुए बाण रावणतनय इन्द्रजीत के शरीर को फोड़ कर, लङ्का में बैसे ही जा जाकर गिरेंगे; जैसे हंस पुष्करिणी में जाते हैं। आज ही उस भयानक राक्षस के शरीर को, मेरे विशाल धनुष के रो।दे से छूटे हुए बाण, फोड़ कर ध्वस्त कर डालेंगे । अपने बड़े भाई से इस प्रकार के बचन कह कर कान्तिमान

verses.sloka: तौ प्रयुद्धौ तदा वीरौ मृधे लक्ष्मणराक्षसौ।शरौघानभिवर्षन्तौ जघ्नतुस्तौ परस्परम् ।। ६.९०.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau prayuddhau tadā vīrau mṛdhe lakṣmaṇarākṣasau।śaraughānabhivarṣantau jaghnatustau parasparam ।। 6.90.27 ।।

translations.english: Mighty Indrajith who can give tough fight to enemies gave a violent fight to his father's brother and again rushed towards Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: अभीक्ष्णमन्तर्दधतुः शरजालैर्महाबलौ।चन्द्रादित्याविवोष्णान्ते यथा मेघैस्तरस्विनौ ।। ६.९०.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: abhīkṣṇamantardadhatuḥ śarajālairmahābalau।candrādityāvivoṣṇānte yathā meghaistarasvinau ।। 6.90.28 ।।

translations.english: In that battle the two heroes, Lakshmana and Indrajith rained streams of arrows on each other and engaged themselves in the battle.

verses.sloka: न ह्यादानं न सन्धानं धनुषो वा परिग्रहः।न विप्रमोक्षो बाणानां न विकर्षो न विग्रहः ।। ६.९०.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: na hyādānaṁ na sandhānaṁ dhanuṣo vā parigrahaḥ।na vipramokṣo bāṇānāṁ na vikarṣo na vigrahaḥ ।। 6.90.29 ।।

translations.english: Both the mighty and energetic heroes, covered each other with arrows just as after summer the moon and Sun are veiled frequently by clouds.

verses.sloka: न मुष्टिप्रतिसन्धानं न लक्ष्यप्रतिपादनम्।अदृश्यत तयोस्तत्र युध्यतोः पाणिलाघवात् ।। ६.९०.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: na muṣṭipratisandhānaṁ na lakṣyapratipādanam।adṛśyata tayostatra yudhyatoḥ pāṇilāghavāt ।। 6.90.30 ।।

translations.english: While both were fighting, due to the quickness of their hand movement, it could not be perceived whether they were taking out arrows from the quiver, drawing the string, or seizing arrows, or aiming to shoot or not. Whether they were drawing or stretching the bow or not or fixing with their fist or hitting the target or not, was not clear.
translations.hindi: ओर इन्द्रजीत के वध करने की अभिलाषा रखने वाले च्मण जी तुरन्त चल दिए। ( चलने के पूव ) उन्होंने श्रीराम- चन्द्र जी को प्रणांस कर, उनकी प्रदक्षिणा की ॥ २६) निकुस्भिलामभिययो चैत्यं रावणिपालितम्‌ । विभीषणेन सहितो राजपुत्रः प्रतापवान्‌

verses.sloka: चापवेगविनिर्मुक्तबाणजालैः समन्ततः।अन्तरिक्षे हि सञ्छन्ने न रूपाणि चकाशिरे ।। ६.९०.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: cāpavegavinirmuktabāṇajālaiḥ samantataḥ।antarikṣe hi sañchanne na rūpāṇi cakāśire ।। 6.90.31 ।।

translations.english: While both were fighting, due to the quickness of their hand movement, it could not be perceived whether they were taking out arrows from the quiver, drawing the string, or seizing arrows, or aiming to shoot or not. Whether they were drawing or stretching the bow or not or fixing with their fist or hitting the target or not, was not clear.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने लक्ष्मण का स्वस्त्यवाचन ( वैदिक मंत्रों से मङ्गलाभिषेक किया ) और वे शीघ्र चल दिए। उनके साथ कई सहस्र बानरें सहित हनुमान्‌

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणो रावणिं प्राप्य रावणिश्चापि लक्ष्मणम्।अव्यवस्था भवत्युग्रा ताभ्यामन्योन्यविग्रहे ।। ६.९०.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇo rāvaṇiṁ prāpya rāvaṇiścāpi lakṣmaṇam।avyavasthā bhavatyugrā tābhyāmanyonyavigrahe ।। 6.90.32 ।।

translations.english: As they were discharging arrows from the bow swiftly, the arrows formed a net covering all over the sky and no object could be visible.
translations.hindi: अर अपने मंत्रियों के साथ विभीषण चले। ( सारांश यह कि ) अपने साथ वानरों की एक बिशाल सेनाले जाते हुए लक्ष्मण जी ने

verses.sloka: ताभ्यामुभाभ्यां तरसा विसृष्टैर्विशिखैः शितैः।निरन्तरमिवाकाशं बभूव तमसावृतम् ।। ६.९०.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tābhyāmubhābhyāṁ tarasā visṛṣṭairviśikhaiḥ śitaiḥ।nirantaramivākāśaṁ babhūva tamasāvṛtam ।। 6.90.33 ।।

translations.english: As Lakshmana was meeting Indrajith and Indrajith was reaching out to Lakshmana, confusion prevailed about who was hitting whom?
translations.hindi: राते भें तैयार खड़ी जाम्बवान्‌ की सेना को भी देखा । शत्रु को सन्तापित करने वाले लक्ष्मण जी ने बहुत दूर: जाने के बाद

verses.sloka: तैः पतद्भिश्च बहुभिस्तयोः शरशतैः शितैः।दिशश्च प्रदिशश्चैव बभूवुः शरसङ्कुलाः ।। ६.९०.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: taiḥ patadbhiśca bahubhistayoḥ śaraśataiḥ śitaiḥ।diśaśca pradiśaścaiva babhūvuḥ śarasaṅkulāḥ ।। 6.90.34 ।।

translations.english: while both of them one over the other swiftly extended and loosened the whetted arrows continuously, the sky, shrouded with arrows, became dark.
translations.hindi: विष्ठितम्‌ संस्थितम्‌ | (शि०) २ मायायोगं-मायारूपोप््यं । . गो०_) ३ बह विधानेन--ब्रह्मवरदानप्रकारेण । ( गो० ) ६३२ युद्धकाण्डे दुर ही से इन्द्रजीत को, अपनी सेना का व्यूह बनाए खड़ा हुआ देखा । फिर शात्रहन्ता लक्ष्मण जी उसे देख ओर हाथ में धनुष ले, ब्रह्मा के वरदानानुसार मायारूपी उपाय से वध करने के लिए बहीं ठहरे रहे । प्रतापी राजकुमार लक्ष्मण के साथ महा बीर अङ्गद, पवननन्दन हनुमान ओर राक्षतराजञ विभीषण भी ठहर गए

verses.sloka: तमसा संवृतं सर्वमासीद्भीमतरं महत्।अस्तं गते सहस्रांशौ संवृतं तमसेव हि ।। ६.९०.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamasā saṁvṛtaṁ sarvamāsīdbhīmataraṁ mahat।astaṁ gate sahasrāṁśau saṁvṛtaṁ tamaseva hi ।। 6.90.35 ।।

translations.english: Many hundreds of pointed arrows falling in all directions and intermediate points spread all over.

verses.sloka: रुधिरौघमहानद्यः प्रावर्तन्त सहस्रशः।क्रव्यादा दारुणा वाग्भिश्चिक्षिपुर्भीमनिस्वनम् ।। ६.९०.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: rudhiraughamahānadyaḥ prāvartanta sahasraśaḥ।kravyādā dāruṇā vāgbhiścikṣipurbhīmanisvanam ।। 6.90.36 ।।

translations.english: As the sun sank down, darkness enveloped, everything was dark and dreadful in appearance. Streams of blood of thousands flowed.
translations.hindi: इति पंचाशीतितमः सगः ॥ राक्षसा की सेना विविध प्रकार से चमचमाते शस्त्र लिये हुए शोभायमान हो रही थी । वह सेना रथां और ध्वजदश्डा से बहुत बढ़ी और दुर्गम हो रहो थी । उसका बड़ा ही भयङ्कर वेग था। लोग जिस प्रकार निबिड़ अन्धकार में घुसते हैं, उसो प्रकार महाचीर लक्ष्मण जी ने उस सेना सें प्रवेश किआ

verses.sloka: न तदानीं ववौ वायुर्न च जज्वाल पावकः।स्वस्त्यस्तु लोकेभ्य इति जजल्पुश्च महर्षयः ।। ६.९०.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: na tadānīṁ vavau vāyurna ca jajvāla pāvakaḥ।svastyastu lokebhya iti jajalpuśca maharṣayaḥ ।। 6.90.37 ।।

translations.english: Carnivorous animals cried frightfully with their tongues. Wind did not blow, the fire did not glow.

verses.sloka: सम्पेतुश्चात्र सम्प्राप्ता गन्धर्वाः सह चारणैः ।। ६.९०.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sampetuścātra samprāptā gandharvāḥ saha cāraṇaiḥ ।। 6.90.38 ।।

translations.english: Sages murmured saying" may this world be well." Gandharvas, Charanas (who came to see the battle) went distressed.

verses.sloka: अथ राक्षससिंहस्य कृष्णान् कनकभूषणान्।शरैश्चतुर्भिः सौमित्रिर्विव्याध चतुरो हयान् ।। ६.९०.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha rākṣasasiṁhasya kṛṣṇān kanakabhūṣaṇān।śaraiścaturbhiḥ saumitrirvivyādha caturo hayān ।। 6.90.39 ।।

translations.english: Then Saumithri pierced with four shafts all the four black horses decked in gold, of the lion of Rakshasas (Indrajith) and finished them

verses.sloka: ततो ऽपरेण भल्लेन शितेन निशितेन च।सम्पूर्णायतमुक्तेन सुपत्रेण सुवर्चसा ।। ६.९०.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'pareṇa bhallena śitena niśitena ca।sampūrṇāyatamuktena supatreṇa suvarcasā ।। 6.90.40 ।।

translations.english: Then glorious Raghava with pointed bhalla furnished with beautiful plumes, splendid, deadly as Indra's thunderbolt, released and as it resounded the hit of the sword and severed the head from the body of the charioteer, who was driving in circles.

verses.sloka: महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन सुतस्य विचरिष्यतः।स तेन बाणाशनिना तलशब्दानुनादिना ।। ६.९०.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahendrāśanikalpena sutasya vicariṣyataḥ।sa tena bāṇāśaninā talaśabdānunādinā ।। 6.90.41 ।।

translations.english: Then glorious Raghava with pointed bhalla furnished with beautiful plumes, splendid, deadly as Indra's thunderbolt, released and as it resounded the hit of the sword and severed the head from the body of the charioteer, who was driving in circles.

verses.sloka: लाघवाद्राघवः श्रीमान् शिरः कायादपाहरत् ।। ६.९०.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: lāghavādrāghavaḥ śrīmān śiraḥ kāyādapāharat ।। 6.90.42 ।।

translations.english: Then glorious Raghava with pointed bhalla furnished with beautiful plumes, splendid, deadly as Indra's thunderbolt, released and as it resounded the hit of the sword and severed the head from the body of the charioteer, who was driving in circles.

verses.sloka: स यन्तरि महातेजा हते मन्दोदरीसुतः ।। ६.९०.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa yantari mahātejā hate mandodarīsutaḥ ।। 6.90.43 ।।

translations.english: When the charioteer got killed, the brilliant son of Mandodari, played the role of charioteer and wielded the bow again.

verses.sloka: स्वयं सारथ्यमकरोत् पुनश्च धनुरस्पृशत्।तदद्भुतमभूत्तत्र सामर्थ्यं पश्यतां युधि ।। ६.९०.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: svayaṁ sārathyamakarot punaśca dhanuraspṛśat।tadadbhutamabhūttatra sāmarthyaṁ paśyatāṁ yudhi ।। 6.90.44 ।।

translations.english: While Indrajith was engaged with the horses in one hand and battling, his capacity was a wonder to the onlookers. Lakshmana again attacked him loosening pointed arrows at him while Indrajith was busy with his bow.

verses.sloka: हयेषु व्यग्रहस्तं तं विव्याध निशितैः शरैः।धनुष्यथ पुनर्व्यग्रे हयेषु मुमुचे शरान् ।। ६.९०.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: hayeṣu vyagrahastaṁ taṁ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ।dhanuṣyatha punarvyagre hayeṣu mumuce śarān ।। 6.90.45 ।।

translations.english: While Indrajith was moving undaunted being hurt, Lakshmana who acts with extreme alacrity and fearless easily pierced Indrajith with arrows.

verses.sloka: छिद्रेषु तेषु बाणेषु सौमित्रिः शीघ्रविक्रमः।अर्दयामास बाणौघैर्विचरन्तमभीतवत् ।। ६.९०.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: chidreṣu teṣu bāṇeṣu saumitriḥ śīghravikramaḥ।ardayāmāsa bāṇaughairvicarantamabhītavat ।। 6.90.46 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the charioteer killed, Ravana's son was despondent and lost enthusiasm to fight (said people).

verses.sloka: निहतं सारथिं दृष्ट्वा समरे रावणात्मजः।प्रजहौ समरोद्धर्षं विषण्णः स बभूव ह ।। ६.९०.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: nihataṁ sārathiṁ dṛṣṭvā samare rāvaṇātmajaḥ।prajahau samaroddharṣaṁ viṣaṇṇaḥ sa babhūva ha ।। 6.90.47 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara leaders were joyful upon seeing the worried face of the Rakshasa and acclaimed Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: विषण्णवदनं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसं हरियूथपाः।ततः परमसंहृष्टा लक्ष्मणं चाभ्यपूजयन् ।। ६.९०.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: viṣaṇṇavadanaṁ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaṁ hariyūthapāḥ।tataḥ paramasaṁhṛṣṭā lakṣmaṇaṁ cābhyapūjayan ।। 6.90.48 ।।

translations.english: Then the four monkey leaders, Pramati, Rabahasa, Sarabha, and Gandamadhana exhibited their intolerance and went quickly.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रमाथी शरभो रभसो गन्धमादनः।अमृष्यमाणाश्चत्वारश्चक्रुर्वेगं हरीश्वराः ।। ६.९०.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pramāthī śarabho rabhaso gandhamādanaḥ।amṛṣyamāṇāścatvāraścakrurvegaṁ harīśvarāḥ ।। 6.90.49 ।।

translations.english: The four Vanaras of remarkable valour and of terrific courage getting up immediately fell on the best of the horses (of Indrajith).

verses.sloka: ते चास्य हयमुख्येषु तूर्णमुत्प्लुत्य वानराः।चतुर्षु समहावीर्या निपेतुर्भीमविक्रमाः ।। ६.९०.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: te cāsya hayamukhyeṣu tūrṇamutplutya vānarāḥ।caturṣu samahāvīryā nipeturbhīmavikramāḥ ।। 6.90.50 ।।

translations.english: Those Vanaras of huge mountain forms getting on top of those horses (of Indrajith),

verses.sloka: तेषामधिष्ठितानां तैर्वानरैः पर्वतोपमैः।मुखेभ्यो रुधिरं रक्तं हयानां समवर्तत ।। ६.९०.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāmadhiṣṭhitānāṁ tairvānaraiḥ parvatopamaiḥ।mukhebhyo rudhiraṁ raktaṁ hayānāṁ samavartata ।। 6.90.51 ।।

translations.english: The horses were mutilated, broken, and sunk into the earth and killed. Again, bounding the great chariot, they got up quickly and stood nearby Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: ते हया मथिता भग्ना व्यसवो धरणीं गताः।ते निहत्य हयांस्तस्य प्रमथ्य च महारथम् ।। ६.९०.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: te hayā mathitā bhagnā vyasavo dharaṇīṁ gatāḥ।te nihatya hayāṁstasya pramathya ca mahāratham ।। 6.90.52 ।।

translations.english: The horses were mutilated, broken, and sunk into the earth and killed. Again, bounding the great chariot, they got up quickly and stood nearby Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: पुनरुत्पत्य वेगेन तस्थुर्लक्ष्मणपार्श्वतः।स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य रथान्मथितसारथेः।शरवर्षेण सौमित्रिमभ्यधावत रावणिः ।। ६.९०.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: punarutpatya vegena tasthurlakṣmaṇapārśvataḥ।sa hatāśvādavaplutya rathānmathitasāratheḥ।śaravarṣeṇa saumitrimabhyadhāvata rāvaṇiḥ ।। 6.90.53 ।।

translations.english: Charioteer dead, horses killed that Indrajith leapt down and assailed Lakshmana by raining arrows.

verses.sloka: ततो महेन्द्रप्रतिमः स लक्ष्मणः पदातिनं तं निशितैः शरोत्तमैः।सृजन्तमाजौ निशितान् शरोत्तमान् भृशं तदा बाणगणैर्न्यवारयत् ।। ६.९०.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato mahendrapratimaḥ sa lakṣmaṇaḥ padātinaṁ taṁ niśitaiḥ śarottamaiḥ।sṛjantamājau niśitān śarottamān bhṛśaṁ tadā bāṇagaṇairnyavārayat ।। 6.90.54 ।।

translations.english: Then Lakshmana, the peer of great Indra, with volleys of arrows firmly held back that foe who, his excellent horses slain, now fought on foot, yet kept loosing his sharp and excellent shafts as before.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे नवतितमः सर्गः ।। ९० ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe navatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 90 ।।
